name: Bubbits Demo
author: Addicting Games
description:
Find Bubbits on Steam now!

 

Pop your way to victory in a colorful next generation Bubble Shooter. Perfect for casual and competitive players alike! Compete in a 25 Player Battle Royale or go solo in the Daily Challenge or the Adventure Mode. Customize your playfield, unleash Power Ups and experience crazy battle events that shake up the game!
